name: Notes App
install:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci
elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install
else echo "No Node.js project on this revision; skipping npm install"
fi

terminals.name: server
terminals.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run dev:server; else echo 'Notes app not present on this revision'; fi

terminals.name: client
terminals.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run dev:client; else echo 'Notes app not present on this revision'; fi
